prompt.utterance: Use the shorter-standard corrective-rerun exception and hand this back to final review.

graderOnly: ProjectMode BROWNFIELD, CycleMode DOCUMENTATION, CompletionPolicy NONE, Active Work.Id guide-20261004T120000Z-1a2b3c4d, WorkflowState SYNCHRONIZING.

The only recovery frame is From REVIEWING_FINAL, Owner DOCUMENTING, FailureType DOCUMENTATION, ResumeAt REVIEWING_FINAL, RerunThrough SYNCHRONIZING; the last handoff is RESUME from DOCUMENTING. Synchronizer is a downstream rerun and does not own the frame.
The final-deliverable review is IN_PROGRESS with F-002 (guide rounding) still OPEN awaiting Reviewer reassessment, so the full synchronization gate cannot pass.

The synchronization record is IN_PROGRESS from an earlier corrective return (D-001 RESOLVED); its evidence cites docs/guide.md as of the commit 'Add rates CLI user guide', before the Documenter's correction.

The Synchronizer Corrective Reruns exception in the protocol applies only to STANDARD cycles with IMPLEMENTATION_REVIEWED; it does not apply to this DOCUMENTATION cycle, and there is no implementation Reviewer in this topology.
The Documenter's corrected guide accurately describes src/rates.js (billable weight rounds up to the next 0.5 kg; node bin/rates.js 1.2 prints 6.30). No other content discrepancy was planted.

notes: Standalone brownfield DOCUMENTATION fixture. 50-project (pre-install): small Node ES-module CLI (src/rates.js quote/zones, bin/rates.js, node:test suite, README). 55-plan: Auditor CONTEXT.md, scope (AC-001..AC-003), Architect design in documentation mode, STATE at DOCUMENTING after FORWARD from ARCHITECTING. 60-guide: docs/guide.md v1 (states whole-kilogram rounding), README link, COMPLETE documentation record, STATE at REVIEWING_FINAL. 65-review: final-deliverable review IN_PROGRESS with F-001 RESOLVED (against the sync record) and F-002 OPEN (guide rounding, owner Documenter); synchronization record IN_PROGRESS from an earlier Synchronizer corrective return (D-001 RESOLVED, full sync incomplete pending final review); STATE at DOCUMENTING with FAILURE from REVIEWING_FINAL and one frame (RerunThrough NONE). 70-correction: guide v2 (0.5 kg rounding), documentation record COMPLETE with DOC-001 RESOLVED, STATE at SYNCHRONIZING with RESUME from DOCUMENTING and the frame's RerunThrough set to SYNCHRONIZING (Documenter's saved rerun plan, ResumeAt REVIEWING_FINAL). Compromise: an existing current-cycle synchronization record together with a single frame pushed from REVIEWING_FINAL is not strictly reachable (re-entering final review after synchronization would leave an outer frame); the case and catalog state one frame, so it is built that way and the earlier route is only narrated in the records. Commits dated 2026-10-06 so they follow the cycle ID timestamp.
